rows.uncertainty: Months value [1] is 30 days converted, and assumes 'after treatment' means after the final session; the number of sessions is not in abstract. Design conflict: abstract says split-body and single-blinded; registry says intervention model PARALLEL and masking DOUBLE (participant, outcomes assessor), while its description says split body. Who was blinded is not in abstract. Enrolment: registry estimated 30; abstract reports twenty-nine [29] included; withdrawals and number analysed not in abstract. Sponsor and authorship: registry lead sponsor is 'Clinica Dermatologica Arbache ltda', which shares the first author's surname [inferred link; funding and conflict statements not in abstract]. Registry: status UNKNOWN (last known RECRUITING), last update 2019, no posted results, IPD sharing NO; registry titles call the procedure microneedling, abstract calls it tattoo-machine delivery. A fall in the achromic count does not show that spots match surrounding skin; partial and complete repigmentation are not separated. Medians are of per-limb lesion counts; total lesions and lesions per patient not in abstract. Registry inclusion ages 30 to 70; abstract says only adults; skin tone of enrolled patients not in abstract. Between-arm comparison given only as a p value; no effect size or confidence interval in abstract. The saline limbs also improved (see saline row) [so part of this change may not be due to 5FU].

Masking: DOUBLE (PARTICIPANT, OUTCOMES_ASSESSOR)

Lead sponsor: Clinica Dermatologica Arbache ltda

Fitzpatrick skin types III - V

verifier.notes: First check of the fresh record, from papers/excerpts/arbache2023.txt alone. Failed cells: none. All 29 quotes found verbatim and match their cells, arms and time point. time_from_last_treatment: source says '30 days after treatment'; the assumption that this means after the final session is stated in uncertainty. analysis_unit limb matches 'median number of achromic lesions ... in 5FU-treated limbs'. outcome_tier lesion_count is the weakest reading. Overshoot, scarring, attrition marked missing or as reported. Advisory only (not a failed cell): the registry sets the local adverse event time frame at 30 days, so 'no adverse events' covers 30 days at most.
